name: agentic-benchmark-assessments
description: A dataset of human and automated assessments of agentic LLM behaviors across a variety of tasks, designed to measure how well models perform as autonomous agents. It captures qualitative and quantitative evaluations of planning, tool use, and multi-step task execution to benchmark agentic capabilities. The suite is intended to support comparative analysis of agent performance and alignment properties.
reputation: A recent, research-oriented dataset from UIUC Kang Lab with growing interest but limited widespread adoption so far.
